title_zh: 比较推理：使音频语言模型更好地比较情感
title_en: Comparative Reasoning: Making an Audio Language Model Better at Comparing Emotions
authors: Abinay Reddy Naini；Jaeyeon Kim；Chao-Han Huck Yang；Shinji Watanabe；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 可以对音频进行推理，但目前尚不清楚它们是否可以在情感、环境、语言、韵律和人际维度上对两个语音信号进行比较判断。我们在语音情感识别 (SER) 的背景下研究这个问题，其中模型确定哪种话语表现出更高的唤醒度、效价或优势。我们引入了一种推理引导的序数 SER 框架，该框架以成对的语音输入为条件对 LALM 进行训练。该模型使用以下方法进行训练：从语义音频描述和源自 GeMAPS 特征的声学证据生成的推理轨迹，从而实现可解释的比较决策。除了直接监督之外，我们还采用直接偏好...
abstract_en: Large audio-language models (LALMs) can reason about audio, yet it remains unclear whether they can perform comparative judgments between two speech signals along emotional, environmental, linguistic, prosodic, and interpersonal dimensions.We study this question in the context of speech emotion recognition (SER), where the model determines which utterance exhibits higher arousal, valence, or dominance.We introduce a reasoning-guided ordinal SER framework that conditions an LALM on paired speech inputs.The model is trained using reasoning traces generated from both semantic audio descriptions and acoustic evidence derived from GeMAPS features, enabling interpretable comparative decisions.Beyond direct supervision, we also employ direct preference optimization to encourage stronger separation for emotional differences.Experiments show that the proposed framework improves preference prediction while requiring only 5% of the training data used by conventional ordinal SER systems.

title_zh: 超越多数投票的推理：语音情感识别的可解释语音框架
title_en: Reasoning beyond Majority Vote: An Explainable Speechlm Framework for Speech Emotion Recognition
venue: IEEE International Conference on Acoustics Speech and Signal Processing
authors: Bo-Hao Su；Hui-Ying Shih；Jinchuan Tian；Jiatong Shi；Chi-Chun Lee；Carlos Busso；Shinji Watanabe
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
topics: 情感大模型；情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 语音情绪识别 (SER) 通常在多数投票标签上进行训练和评估，这简化了基准测试，但掩盖了主观性，并且对做出预测的原因几乎不透明。这忽略了有效的少数注释并限制了可解释性。我们提出了一个可解释的语音语言模型（SpeechLM）框架，将 SER 框架为生成推理任务。给定一个话语，该模型首先生成一个转录本，然后输出一个情感标签和一个基于词汇和声学线索的简洁的自然语言原理。基本原理由具有推理能力的大语言模型教师生成，并用作中间监督，并在微调过程中与多数标签相结合。与之前的工作主要不同...
abstract_en: Speech Emotion Recognition (SER) is typically trained and evaluated on majority-voted labels, which simplifies benchmarking but masks subjectivity and provides little transparency into why predictions are made. This neglects valid minority annotations and limits interpretability. We propose an explainable Speech Language Model (SpeechLM) framework that frames SER as a generative reasoning task. Given an utterance, the model first produces a transcript, then outputs both an emotion label and a concise natural-language rationale grounded in lexical and acoustic cues. Rationales are generated by a reasoning-capable teacher LLM and used as intermediate supervision, combined with majority labels during fine-tuning. Unlike prior work primarily focused on boosting classification accuracy, we aim to enhance explainability while preserving competitive performance. To this end, we complement majority-label metrics with annotator-aware scoring that credits matches with any annotator label. On MSP-Podcast v1.12, our model maintains improvements over zero-shot SpeechLM baselines, and produces rationales that human evaluators find plausible and well grounded. This demonstrates that incorporating rationale supervision offers a practical path toward interpretable SER without sacrificing predictive quality.

title_zh: 改善语音情感识别迁移学习中对微调数据的依赖
title_en: Improving the Dependency on Fine-Tuning Data in Transfer Learning for Speech Emotion Recognition
authors: Ricardo García；Rodrigo Mahú；Carlos Busso；Néstor Becerra Yoma
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 补偿声学环境中的训练测试不匹配对于可部署的语音解决方案非常重要。本文提出通过使用基于特征最大似然线性回归（fMLLR）算法的补偿机制来减少迁移学习中所需的微调数据量，以减轻训练与测试不匹配的情况。我们的方案结合了自动编码器来减少可训练参数的数量。在编码器潜在空间上操作，我们的补偿策略采用仿射线性变换来解释特征空间中的旋转和移位。我们在现实的人机交互场景中的语音情感识别（SER）任务中评估所提出的解决方案。结果表明，预...
abstract_en: Compensating for train-test mismatches in acoustic environments is important for deployable speech solutions. This paper proposes to reduce the amount of fine-tuning data needed in transfer learning to mitigate the train-test mismatch by using a compensation mechanism based on the feature maximum likelihood linear regression (fMLLR) algorithm. Our scheme incorporates an autoencoder to reduce the number of trainable parameters. Operating on the encoder latent space, our compensation strategy employs an affine linear transform that accounts for rotations and shifts in the feature space. We evaluate the proposed solution in a speech emotion recognition (SER) task within a realistic human-robot interaction scenario. The results show that the proposed architecture outperforms the original scheme without the compensation strategy. We observe a performance gain in the mean concordance correlation coefficient (CCC) of 16.8% using 12.9% of the training set, and 14.4% using 50% of the training set.

title_zh: 共振峰引导语音修复，增强构音障碍语音的理解
title_en: Formant-Guided Speech Repair for Enhanced Comprehension of Dysarthric Speech
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 构音障碍严重降低了语音清晰度，限制了有效的沟通和社会参与。虽然神经重建显示出了希望，但大多数方法都以黑匣子的方式运行，忽略了已知的声学模式，例如人类语音感知基础的元音共振峰。我们提出了一个具有共振峰对齐频谱变换（FAST）模块的模块化框架。与隐式方法不同，FAST 通过在合成之前纠正扭曲的共振峰来显式规范声学空间。与构音障碍适应的 ASR 和说话人自适应 TTS，我们的系统在保留身份和韵律的同时增强了可懂度。在普通话和英语数据集上的实验证明了很强的泛化性。
abstract_en: Dysarthria severely degrades speech intelligibility, limiting effective communication and social participation.While neural reconstruction shows promise, most methods operate as black boxes that overlook known acoustic patterns, e.g., vowel formants that are fundamental to human speech perception.We propose a modular framework featuring a formant-aligned spectral transformation (FAST) module.Unlike implicit approaches, FAST explicitly regularizes the acoustic space by correcting distorted formants prior to synthesis.Integrated with dysarthria-adapted ASR and speaker-adaptive TTS, our system enhances intelligibility while preserving identity and prosody.Experiments on Mandarin and English datasets demonstrate strong generalization.On the primary corpus, the framework achieves a 72.4% relative reduction in CER.Subjective evaluations further indicate over 90% gains in intelligibility, comprehension, and fluency, with listening effort reduced by 60.9%.

title_zh: 构音障碍的多模态生物标志物：言语、文本和面部不对称的严重程度对比对准
title_en: Multimodal Biomarkers of Dysarthria: Severity-Conditioned Contrastive Alignment of Speech, Text, and Facial Asymmetry
authors: Karen Rosero；Chi-Chun Lee；Rami R. Hallac；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 构音障碍是一种影响言语产生的运动性言语障碍，结合听觉和视觉生物标志物可以有益于严重程度评估。虽然最近的进展改进了基于单峰的评估，但大多数系统并未充分利用面部运动、不对称性或所产生的语音与其预期语言内容之间的关系。在这项工作中，我们提出了一个多模式构音障碍严重程度评估（MMDyS）框架，该框架利用了语音、文本和视觉生物标记的对齐。我们引入了一种以严重程度为条件的对比目标，将语音-文本不匹配视为连续的损伤信号，而视觉模态依赖于半脸偏侧化来捕获不对称的发音...
abstract_en: Dysarthria is a motor speech disorder that affects speech production, and severity assessment can benefit from combining acoustic and visual biomarkers. While recent advances have improved unimodal-based evaluations, most systems do not fully leverage facial motion, asymmetry, or the relationship between the produced speech and its intended linguistic content. In this work, we propose a framework for MultiModal Dysarthria Severity assessment (MMDyS), which exploits the alignment of speech, text, and visual biomarkers. We introduce a severity-conditioned contrastive objective that treats speech–text mismatch as a continuous signal of impairment, while the visual modality relies on hemiface lateralization to capture asymmetric articulatory patterns, complemented by temporal segmentation and flow motion descriptors. These representations are integrated through a mixture-of-experts mechanism with cross-modal alignment, enabling adaptive weighting of speech, text, and visual evidence. Evaluated on the Mandarin speech dysarthria multimodal (MSDM) benchmark, MMDyS achieves a subject-level macro F1 of 0.92 and the composite multimodal dysarthria severity assessment (MDSA) score of 11.7% over the current state-of-the-art. Our results show that modeling speech–text divergence and facial asymmetry leads to more informative and robust multimodal representations for dysarthria severity assessment. Code is available at: https://github.com/Lab-MSP/MMDyS.

title_zh: 利用多模态未标记数据增强语音情感识别
title_en: Harnessing Multimodal Unlabeled Data for Enhanced Speech Emotion Recognition
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
topics: 情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 由于缺乏大型带注释的数据集，语音情感识别（SER）经常面临挑战。大量未标记数据的存在提供了探索可以显着改进 SER 系统的方法的机会。本研究探讨了通过结合源自未标记数据的单模态和多模态训练目标来增强通用语音模型的可行性，这些目标是专门为提取情感内容而定制的。这些多模态目标旨在完善基于自我监督学习 (SSL) 的表示，虽然在 SER 中有效，但最初并不是为了从语音中提取情感线索而创建的。我们的方法引入了一组多模式目标，重点是从三个主要来源捕获信息：声学......
abstract_en: Speech emotion recognition(SER) often faces challenges due to the lack of large, annotated datasets. The presence of abundance unlabeled data offers a chance to explore methods that could significantly improve SER systems. This study explores the feasibility of enhancing general speech models by incorporating unimodal and multimodal training objectives derived from unlabeled data, specifically tailored to extract emotional content. These multimodal objectives aim to refineself-supervised learning(SSL)-based representations that, while effective in SER, were not originally created to extract emotional cues from speech. Our methodology introduces a set of multimodal objectives focused on capturing information from three primary sources: acoustic signals, through a representation objective based on the extendedGeneva Minimalistic Acoustic Parameter Set(eGEMAPS); facial expressions, via visual representations obtained from a pre-trained facial expression recognition system; and textual content, through pseudo-labels generated by a pre-trained emotion sentiment model. These objectives are automatically generated from 70.7 hours of unlabeled emotional content captured in naturalistic settings. We apply our strategy to four state-of-the-art SSL-based speech models, aiming to enhance their capabilities in SER tasks with multimodal signals while still keeping inference strictly audio-only. Our experimental evaluations across the CREMA-D, MSP-IMPROV, and MSP-Podcast datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly improves SER performance, especially in settings with limited labeled data.

title_zh: 论口语模型评价中的全局令牌困惑谬误
title_en: On the Fallacy of Global Token Perplexity in Spoken Language Model Evaluation
authors: Ju-Chieh Chou；Kai-Wei Chang；Yen-Chun Kuo；Chan-Jan Hsu；Yi-Cheng Lin；Liang-Hsuan Tseng；Carlos Busso；Hung-yi Lee
primary_category: 文本情感分析、情绪原因与认知语义
abstract_zh: 在大规模原始音频上预训练的生成口语模型可以继续提供适当内容的语音提示，同时保留说话者和情感等属性，作为口语对话的基础模型。在之前的文献中，这些模型通常使用“全局令牌困惑度”进行评估，它将文本困惑度公式直接应用于语音令牌。然而，这种做法忽略了语音和文本模式之间的根本差异，可能导致低估语音特征。在这项工作中，我们提出了各种基于可能性和生成的评估方法，以代替朴素的全局令牌困惑。我们证明所提出的评估更合理......
abstract_en: Generative spoken language models pretrained on large-scale raw audio can continue a speech prompt with appropriate content while preserving attributes like speaker and emotion, serving as foundation models for spoken dialogue. In prior literature, these models are often evaluated using ``global token perplexity'', which directly applies the text perplexity formulation to speech tokens. However, this practice overlooks fundamental differences between speech and text modalities, possibly leading to an underestimation of the speech characteristics. In this work, we propose a variety of likelihood- and generative-based evaluation methods that serve in place of naive global token perplexity. We demonstrate that the proposed evaluations more faithfully reflect perceived generation quality, as evidenced by stronger correlations with human-rated mean opinion scores (MOS). When assessed under the new metrics, the relative performance landscape of spoken language models is reshaped, revealing a significantly reduced gap between the best-performing model and the human topline. Together, these results suggest that appropriate evaluation is critical for accurately assessing progress in spoken language modeling.

title_zh: 描述你在哪里：通过环境的文本描述提高语音情感识别的噪声鲁棒性
title_en: Describe Where You Are: Improving Noise-Robustness for Speech Emotion Recognition With Text Description of the Environment
authors: Jukka-Pekka Onnela；Seong-Gyun Leem；David Gard；Daniel Fulford；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪

abstract_zh: 语音情感识别 (SER) 系统经常在现实环境中陷入困境，环境噪声会严重降低其性能。本文探讨了一种新颖的方法，该方法利用测试环境的先验知识来最大限度地提高噪声条件下的 SER 性能。为了解决此任务，我们提出了一种文本引导的环境感知训练，其中使用受污染的语音样本及其配对噪声描述来训练 SER 模型。我们使用预先训练的文本编码器来提取基于文本的环境嵌入，然后在训练和推理过程中将其融合到基于 Transformer 的 SER 模型。我们通过 MSP-Podcast 语料库和现实世界的加性噪声 实验证明了我们方法的有效性......
abstract_en: Speech emotion recognition(SER) systems often struggle in real-world environments, where ambient noise severely degrades their performance. This paper explores a novel approach that exploits prior knowledge of testing environments to maximize SER performance under noisy conditions. To address this task, we propose a text-guided, environment-aware training where an SER model is trained with contaminated speech samples and their paired noise description. We use a pre-trained text encoder to extract the text-based environment embedding and then fuse it to a transformer-based SER model during training and inference. We demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through our experiment with the MSP-Podcast corpus and real-world additive noise samples collected from the Freesound and DEMAND repositories. Our experiment indicates that the text-based environment descriptions processed by alarge language model(LLM) produce representations that improve the noise-robustness of the SER system. With acontrastive learning(CL)-based representation, our proposed method can be improved by jointly fine-tuning the text encoder with the emotion recognition model. Under the -5dBsignal-to-noise ratio(SNR) level, fine-tuning the text encoder improves our CL-based representation method by 76.4% (arousal), 100.0% (dominance), and 27.7% (valence).

title_en: Joint Learning Using Mixture-of-Expert-Based Representation for Speech Enhancement and Robust Emotion Recognition
venue: IEEE Transactions on Audio Speech and Language Processing
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 语音情感识别（SER）在构建情感感知语音系统中发挥着关键作用，但其性能在噪声条件下会显着下降。尽管语音增强 (SE) 可以提高鲁棒性，但它通常会引入掩盖情感线索的伪影，并增加管道的计算开销。多任务学习（MTL）通过联合优化 SE 和 SER 任务提供了一种替代方案。然而，传统的共享主干模型经常遭受梯度干扰和任务之间的表示冲突。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了稀疏专家混合表示集成技术（Sparse MERIT），这是一种灵活的 MTL 框架，它将逐帧专家路由应用于自......
abstract_en: Speech emotion recognition (SER) plays a critical role in building emotion-aware speech systems, but its performance degrades significantly under noisy conditions. Although speech enhancement (SE) can improve robustness, it often introduces artifacts that obscure emotional cues and adds computational overhead to the pipeline. Multi-task learning (MTL) offers an alternative by jointly optimizing SE and SER tasks. However, conventional shared-backbone models frequently suffer from gradient interference and representational conflicts between tasks. To address these challenges, we propose the Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Representation Integration Technique (Sparse MERIT), a flexible MTL framework that applies frame-wise expert routing over self-supervised speech representations. Sparse MERIT incorporates task-specific gating networks that dynamically select from a shared pool of experts for each frame, enabling parameter-efficient and task-adaptive representation learning. Experiments on the MSP-Podcast corpus show that Sparse MERIT consistently outperforms baseline models on both SER and SE tasks. Under the most challenging condition of -5 dB signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), Sparse MERIT improves SER F1-macro by an average of 12.0% over a baseline relying on a SE pre-processing strategy, and by 3.4% over a naive MTL baseline, with statistical significance on unseen noise conditions. For SE, Sparse MERIT improves segmental SNR (SSNR) by 28.2% over the SE pre-processing baseline and by 20.0% over the naive MTL baseline. These results demonstrate that Sparse MERIT provides robust and generalizable performance for both emotion recognition and enhancement tasks in noisy environments.

title_zh: 通过多层融合和副语言特征集成恢复离散标记的语音情感识别性能
title_en: Recovering Performance in Speech Emotion Recognition from Discrete Tokens via Multi-Layer Fusion and Paralinguistic Feature Integration
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 离散语音标记为存储和语言模型集成提供了显着的优势，但它们在语音情感识别（SER）中的应用受到量化过程中副语言信息丢失的限制。本文对 SER 的离散令牌进行了全面的研究。使用微调的 WavLM-Large 模型，我们系统地量化了不同层配置和 k 均值量化粒度的性能下降。为了恢复信息丢失，我们提出了两个关键策略：（1）基于注意力的多层融合，以重新捕获来自不同层的互补信息，以及（2）集成 openSMILE 特征以明确地重新引入副语言线索。我们还比较了主流新...
abstract_en: Discrete speech tokens offer significant advantages for storage and language model integration, but their application in speech emotion recognition (SER) is limited by paralinguistic information loss during quantization. This paper presents a comprehensive investigation of discrete tokens for SER. Using a fine-tuned WavLM-Large model, we systematically quantify performance degradation across different layer configurations and k-means quantization granularities. To recover the information loss, we propose two key strategies: (1) attention-based multi-layer fusion to recapture complementary information from different layers, and (2) integration of openSMILE features to explicitly reintroduce paralinguistic cues. We also compare mainstream neural codec tokenizers (SpeechTokenizer, DAC, EnCodec) and analyze their behaviors when fused with acoustic features. Our findings demonstrate that through multi-layer fusion and acoustic feature integration, discrete tokens can close the performance gap with continuous representations in SER tasks.

title_zh: 一天中的时间和地点如何影响体验？被动传感研究
title_en: How do time of day and location influence affect experience? A passive sensing study
authors: Simon M. Li；Molly A. Patapoff；Aanika Schueler；Qimin Liu；David E. Gard；Carlos Busso；Jukka-Pekka “JP” Onnela；Daniel Fulford
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 瞬间的情感体验是由个人所处的环境决定的，但人们对在某些地点（例如，在家里与在公共场所）度过的时间与日常生活中的情感有何关系却知之甚少。在当前的研究中，74 名年轻人完成了为期 14 天的基于智能手机的生态瞬时评估和基于 GPS 的地理定位。我们研究了与年轻人短暂情感（快乐、焦虑和悲伤）相关的三个情境维度：环境情境（在家与室外）、最近暴露时间（前三个小时在家中度过的时间）和时间情境（一天中的时间和一周中的某一天）。多层次模型表明参与者报告了更高的幸福感和更低的焦虑...
abstract_en: Momentary emotional experience is shaped by the contexts in which individuals are embedded, yet little is known about how time spent in certain locations (e.g., at home versus in public spaces) relates to affect in daily life. In the current study, 74 young adults completed 14 days of smartphone-based ecological momentary assessment and GPS-based geolocation. We examined three contextual dimensions in relation to momentary affect (happiness, anxiety, and sadness) in young adults: environmental context (at home versus outside), recent exposure duration (time spent at home in the preceding three hours), and temporal context (time of day and day of week). Multilevel models indicated that participants reported higher happiness and lower anxiety in the evening relative to morning, and higher happiness on weekends than on weekdays. Within individuals, being at home (and time spent at home) was associated with lower happiness than being outside the home. Furthermore, the exploratory analysis suggested that the association between time spent at home and lower happiness was stronger among individuals who typically spent less time at home. These findings suggest that temporal and environmental contexts are associated with momentary happiness, whereas environmental context was not associated with anxiety or sadness.

title_zh: 拥抱：跨文化和表达的基于情感的表达
title_en: EMBRACE: Emotion-Based Representation Across Cultures & Expressions
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP (Findings of EMNLP)
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 由于有限的注释、语言多样性和异构标签空间，构建跨语言泛化的语音情感识别 (SER) 模型仍然具有挑战性。当前的多语言 SER 方法要么依赖于完全共享的模型，要么将训练限制为一小组重叠的情感，从而限制了表达能力的多样性。我们提出了 EMBRACE，一种用于与语言无关的 SER 的多语言语音表示。从计算机视觉中的部分标签学习范式中汲取灵感，EM-BRACE 采用了统一的超集情感建模策略。该方法可以在通过在优化过程中选择性地屏蔽缺失的类别，将数据集与不重叠的情感类别混合起来。为了平衡这种情况...
abstract_en: Building speech emotion recognition (SER) models that generalize across languages remains challenging due to limited annotations, linguistic diversity and heterogeneous label spaces.Current multilingual SER approaches either rely on fully shared models or restrict training to a small set of overlapping emotions that restrict diversity in expressiveness.We propose EMBRACE, a multilingual speech representation for language-agnostic SER.Drawing inspiration from partial-label learning paradigms in computer vision, EM-BRACE adopts a unified superset emotion modeling strategy.The approach enables training on mixtures of datasets with non-overlapping emotion categories by selectively masking absent categories during optimization.To balance this complex multi-domain training, the model leverages a knowledge distillation based progressive training procedure that stabilizes multilingual optimization and mitigates catastrophic forgetting.Experiments across seven languages show that EMBRACE improves cross-corpus performance by 31.8% and in-corpus by 15.2% over strong emotional speech representations, confirming its ability to learn discriminative and transferable affective representations.

title_zh: 用于视听情感识别的分层量化跨模态掩蔽自动编码器
title_en: Hierarchical Quantized Cross-modal Masked Autoencoders for Audio-Visual Emotion Recognition
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
topics: 情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 跨模态自我监督学习在学习视听情感识别（AVER）表示方面表现出了强大的潜力。然而，大多数现有方法完全在连续嵌入空间中运行，这可能会无意中保留不相关的模式、虚假相关性和特定于模态的噪声。为了提高 AVER 模型在噪声条件和域转移下的鲁棒性和泛化性，我们提出了分层量化跨模态掩码自动编码器（HQC-MAE）框架。该方法通过学习的密码本将离散表示学习集成到屏蔽数据建模和对比学习中，从而在多模态设置中创建分层信息瓶颈。我们进行跨模态对比...
abstract_en: Cross-modal self-supervised learning has shown strong potential for learning representations for audio-visual emotion recognition (AVER). However, most existing methods operate entirely in continuous embedding spaces, which can inadvertently preserve irrelevant patterns, spurious correlations, and modality-specific noise. To improve robustness and generalization of AVER models under noisy conditions and domain shift, we propose the hierarchical quantized cross-modal masked autoencoders (HQC-MAE) framework. This method integrates discrete representation learning into masked data modeling and contrastive learning via learned codebooks, creating hierarchical information bottlenecks in a multimodal setting. We perform cross-modal contrastive learning in a discrete space, encouraging semantically aligned audio and video samples to match in a structured embedding space. Our vector quantization modules are integrated into pretrained unimodal foundation models (VideoMAEv2 for video and AudioMAE++ for audio), enabling us to leverage large-scale pretrained unimodal models rather than training them from scratch. Experiments on emotion recognition benchmarks across diverse settings show that HQC-MAE consistently outperforms AVER baselines using continuous representations.

title_zh: 长聆听思维：通过深思熟虑的感知和认知细化引发开放式听觉推理
title_en: Long Listening Thoughts: Eliciting Open Auditory Reasoning with Deliberative Perception and Cognitive Refinement
venue: Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP (Findings of EMNLP)
authors: Jaeyeon Kim；Chao-Han Huck Yang；Luoyi Zhang；Chan-Jan Hsu；Fernando Ruiloba Portilla；Jinchuan Tian；Shinji Watanabe；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 情感理解数据集、评测基准与综述
abstract_zh: 我们引入了 Long Listening Thoughts (LLT)，这是一个用于构建训练后数据集的框架，通过将刻意的感知基础与明确的认知行为相结合来改善音频推理。在音频理解和推理基准上，大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 主要受到感知错误的限制，而现有的训练后数据集依赖于有限多样性的音频描述。通过四级管道，LLT (1) 构建了跨越多个方面的多方面密集音频描述语义、声学和时间信息，（2）生成更具挑战性的问题，（3）合成不正确的推理轨迹，（4）通过引发认知的思维延续策略将短推理轨迹扩展到长推理轨迹。
abstract_en: We introduce Long Listening Thoughts (LLT), a framework for constructing post-training datasets that improves audio reasoning by pairing deliberate perceptual grounding with explicit cognitive behaviors.On audio understanding and reasoning benchmarks, large audio-language models (LALMs) are limited primarily by perceptual errors, yet existing post-training datasets rely on audio descriptions of limited diversity.Through a fourstage pipeline, LLT (1) builds multi-aspect dense audio descriptions spanning semantic, acoustic, and temporal information, (2) generates more challenging questions, (3) synthesizes incorrect reasoning traces, and (4) extends short reasoning traces into long ones via a thought-continuation strategy that elicits cognitive behaviors such as verification and backtracking.Using LLT, we synthesize 1.6M reasoning traces and train Qwen2.5-Omni-7B with a two-stage pipeline of supervised finetuning (SFT) followed by direct preference optimization (DPO).This improves accuracy on MMAU Test-mini (71.5 → 78.2), MMAR (56.7 → 63.7), and MMSU (60.6 → 66.0).

title_zh: 重新思考用于语音生成的说话人嵌入：用于捕获说话人内部多样性的子中心建模
title_en: Rethinking Speaker Embeddings for Speech Generation: Sub-Center Modeling for Capturing Intra-Speaker Diversity
authors: Berrak Sisman；Ismail Rasim Ülgen；Carlos Busso；John H. L. Hansen
primary_category: 情感理解数据集、评测基准与综述
abstract_zh: 对语音变化进行建模是自然、富有表现力的生成的关键。说话人嵌入通常用于调节个性化语音系统，但它们通常是针对说话人识别进行训练的，其中说话人内部的变化被抑制，说话人之间的分离被最大化。这个目标导致过于紧凑的表示，可能会丢弃对生成至关重要的变化。我们重新审视这种设计选择，并提出了一个用于说话人嵌入的子中心建模框架。我们不是为每个说话人使用单个原型，而是在学习期间学习多个子中心。判别性训练，允许话语与不同的原型保持一致。该策略保留结构化的说话人内部变异性，同时保持可辨别性。我...
abstract_en: Modeling speech variation is key to natural, expressive generation.Speaker embeddings are commonly used to condition personalized speech systems, but they are typically trained for speaker recognition, where intra-speaker variability is suppressed and inter-speaker separation is maximized.This objective leads to overly compact representations that may discard variations crucial for generation.We revisit this design choice and propose a sub-center modeling framework for speaker embeddings.Instead of a single prototype per speaker, we learn multiple sub-centers during discriminative training, allowing utterances to align with different prototypes.This strategy preserves structured intra-speaker variability while maintaining discriminability.In zero-shot voice conversion, our method improves intelligibility, increases pitch variability, achieves higher naturalness ratings, and retains strong speaker verification performance.

title_zh: ADEPT：通过证据探测工具对情感进行 RL 对齐代理解码 - 从共识学习到模糊驱动的情感推理
title_en: ADEPT: RL-Aligned Agentic Decoding of Emotion via Evidence Probing Tools - From Consensus Learning to Ambiguity-Driven Emotion Reasoning
authors: Abinay Reddy Naini；Bo-Hao Su；Esther Sun；Shinji Watanabe；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 文本情感分析、情绪原因与认知语义
topics: 情感理解；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 语音大语言模型 (SLLM) 可以实现高级情感推理，但通常会在没有可验证的声学证据的情况下产生无根据的、有文本偏见的判断。相比之下，WavLM 等自监督语音编码器提供了强大的声学表示，但仍然是不透明的判别模型，可解释性有限。为了弥补这一差距，我们引入了 ADEPT（通过证据探测工具对情感进行智能体解码），这是一个将情感识别重新构建为多轮查询过程而不是单通道预测的框架。 ADEPT 将 SLLM 转变为一个智能体，该智能体维护不断变化的候选情绪集，并在候选生成的结构化管道中自适应地调用专用语义和声学探测工具。
abstract_en: Speech Large Language Models (SLLMs) enable high-level emotion reasoning but often produce ungrounded, text-biased judgments without verifiable acoustic evidence. In contrast, self-supervised speech encoders such as WavLM provide strong acoustic representations yet remain opaque discriminative models with limited interpretability. To bridge this gap, we introduce ADEPT (Agentic Decoding of Emotion via Evidence Probing Tools), a framework that reframes emotion recognition as a multi-turn inquiry process rather than a single-pass prediction. ADEPT transforms an SLLM into an agent that maintains an evolving candidate emotion set and adaptively invokes dedicated semantic and acoustic probing tools within a structured pipeline of candidate generation, evidence collection, and adjudication. Crucially, ADEPT enables a paradigm shift from consensus learning to ambiguity-driven emotion reasoning. Since human affect exhibits inherent complexity and frequent co-occurrence of emotions, we treat minority annotations as informative perceptual signals rather than discarding them as noise. Finally, we integrate Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) with an Evidence Trust Gate to explicitly couple tool-usage behaviors with prediction quality and enforce evidence-grounded reasoning. Experiments show that ADEPT improves primary emotion accuracy in most settings while substantially improving minor emotion characterization, producing explanations grounded in auditable acoustic and semantic evidence.

title_zh: AffectDF：针对情感表达攻击的语音 Deepfake 检测的最全面基准
title_en: AffectDF: The Most Comprehensive Benchmark for Speech Deepfake Detection against Emotionally Expressive Attacks
venue: Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP)
authors: Aurosweta Mahapatra；Xiutian Zhao；Shreeram Suresh Chandra；Zihan Zhang；Zongyang Du；İsmail Rasim Ülgen；Kong Aik Lee；Nicholas Andrews；Carlos Busso；Berrak Sisman
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 语音深度伪造检测（SDD）系统在传统基准测试中实现了强劲的性能；然而，现有数据集对情感表达和最近基于大型音频语言模型 (LALM) 的攻击的覆盖范围有限。现有的情感欺骗数据集在规模和攻击多样性方面也受到限制，通常仅涵盖语音转换 (VC) 或文本到语音 (TTS) 攻击。我们引入 AffectDF，这是情感表达语音深度伪造的最全面的基准，涵盖 TTS、VC、情感 VC 和基于 LALM 的欺骗攻击表演和自发的情感语音。Af-fectDF 包含使用跨五种情绪状态的 21 次欺骗攻击生成的大约 260 小时的语音。我们对状态进行基准测试...
abstract_en: Speech deepfake detection (SDD) systems achieve strong performance on conventional benchmarks; however, existing datasets provide limited coverage of emotionally expressive and recent large audio-language model (LALM)based attacks.Existing emotional spoofing datasets are also limited in scale and attack diversity, typically covering only voice conversion (VC) or text-to-speech (TTS) attacks.We introduce AffectDF, the most comprehensive benchmark for emotionally expressive speech deepfakes, spanning TTS, VC, emotional VC, and LALM-based spoofing attacks across both acted and spontaneous emotional speech.Af-fectDF contains approximately 260 hours of speech generated using 21 spoofing attacks across five emotional states.We benchmark state-of-the-art SDD systems under conventional and emotional spoofing conditions, including LALM-based detectors evaluated with both inference-only prompting and supervised fine-tuning.Our experiments reveal severe robustness degradation when models trained on conventional benchmarks are evaluated on Af-fectDF, with several systems approaching nearrandom performance.Surprisingly, even largescale emotional training does not consistently improve cross-domain robustness, indicating that current SDD systems fail to learn generalized spoof representations under emotional and prosodic variability.Robustness further varies substantially across emotional states, attack families, and acted vs spontaneous emotional speech conditions.These findings expose fundamental limitations of current SDD systems and establish AffectDF as a benchmark for developing more robust spoof detection models.

title_zh: FedMLAC：相互学习驱动的异构联合音频分类
title_en: FedMLAC: Mutual learning driven heterogeneous federated audio classification
authors: Youyang Qu；Rajib Rana；Xiaohui Tao；Di Wu；Jun Bai；Ji Zhang；Palaiahnakote Shivakumara；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 情感理解数据集、评测基准与综述
abstract_zh: 联邦学习 (FL) 提供了一个隐私保护框架，用于跨分散客户端训练音频分类 (AC) 模型，而无需共享原始数据。然而，联合音频分类面临三大挑战：数据异构性、模型异构性和数据损坏，这会降低现实环境中的性能。虽然现有方法通常单独解决这些问题，但统一的解决方案仍未得到充分探索。我们提出了 FedMLAC，这是一个基于相互学习的 FL 框架，可以同时解决所有三个挑战。每个客户端维护一个个性化的本地AC模型和一个轻量级的、全局共享的Plug-in模型。这些模型通过双向知识蒸馏进行交互，从而实现全球知识……
abstract_en: Federated Learning (FL) offers a privacy-preserving framework for training audio classification (AC) models across decentralized clients without sharing raw data. However, Federated Audio Classification faces three major challenges: data heterogeneity , model heterogeneity , and data corruption , which degrade performance in real-world settings. While existing methods often address these issues separately, a unified solution remains underexplored. We propose FedMLAC, a mutual learning-based FL framework that tackles all three challenges simultaneously. Each client maintains a personalized local AC model and a lightweight, globally shared Plug-in model. These models interact via bidirectional knowledge distillation, enabling global knowledge sharing while adapting to local data distributions, thus addressing both data and model heterogeneity. To counter data corruption, we introduce a Layer-wise Pruning Aggregation (LPA) strategy that filters anomalous Plug-in updates based on parameter deviations during aggregation. Extensive experiments on four diverse AC benchmarks, including both speech and non-speech tasks, show that FedMLAC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines in classification accuracy and robustness to noisy data.

title_zh: Interspeech 2026 音频推理挑战赛：评估音频推理模型和智能体的推理过程质量
title_en: The Interspeech 2026 Audio Reasoning Challenge: Evaluating Reasoning Process Quality for Audio Reasoning Models and Agents
authors: Yinghao Ma；Ziyang Ma；Chao-Han Huck Yang；Bohan Li；Kai Yu；Jaeyeon Kim；Ruiyang Xu；Chng Eng Siong；Carlos Busso；Xie Chen；Jinyu Li；Jin Xu
primary_category: 情感理解数据集、评测基准与综述
topics: 多模态与大语言模型；强化学习与决策优化
abstract_zh: 最近的大型音频语言模型（LALM）在理解方面表现出色，但往往缺乏透明的推理。为了解决这种“黑匣子”限制，我们在 Interspeech 2026 上组织了音频推理挑战赛，这是第一个致力于评估音频领域思想链（CoT）质量的共享任务。该挑战赛引入了 MMAR-Rubrics，这是一种新颖的实例级协议，用于评估推理链的事实性和逻辑性。特色单一模型和智能体曲目，竞赛吸引了众多人来自18个国家和地区的156支团队。结果显示，智能体系统目前在推理质量上处于领先地位，利用迭代工具编排和跨模态分析。此外，单一模型通过强化学习和复杂的技术正在快速发展......
abstract_en: Recent Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) excel in understanding but often lack transparent reasoning.To address this "black-box" limitation, we organized the Audio Reasoning Challenge at Interspeech 2026, the first shared task dedicated to evaluating Chain-of-Thought (CoT) quality in the audio domain.The challenge introduced MMAR-Rubrics, a novel instance-level protocol assessing the factuality and logic of reasoning chains.Featured Single Model and Agent tracks, the competition attracting 156 teams from 18 countries and regions.Results show agent systems currently lead in reasoning quality, utilizing iterative tool orchestration and cross-modal analysis.Besides, single models are rapidly advancing via reinforcement learning and sophisticated data pipeline.We details the challenge design, methodology, and a comprehensive analysis of state-of-the-art systems, providing new insights for explainable audio intelligence.1

title_zh: MSP 播客语料库
title_en: The MSP-Podcast Corpus
authors: Wei-Cheng Lin；Seong-Gyun Leem；Abinay Reddy Naini；Kusha Sridhar；Srinivas Parthasarathy；Huang-Cheng Chou；Lucas Goncalves；Reza Lotfian；Ali N. Salman；Luz Martinez-Lucas；Pravin Mote；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 大型、高质量的情感语音数据库的可用性对于在现实场景中推进语音情感识别 (SER) 至关重要。然而，许多现有数据库面临着规模、情感平衡和说话者多样性方面的限制。本研究描述了 MSP-Podcast 语料库，总结了我们十年来的努力。该语料库由来自各个音频共享网站的 400 多个小时的不同音频样本组成，所有这些网站都拥有允许分发该语料库的通用许可证。我们用丰富的情感标签来注释语料库，包括主要（单一主导情感）和次要（音频中感知的多种情感）情感类别，以及效价、唤醒和主导的情感属性......
abstract_en: The availability of large, high-quality emotional speech databases is essential for advancing speech emotion recognition (SER) in real-world scenarios. However, many existing databases face limitations in size, emotional balance, and speaker diversity. This study describes the MSP-Podcast corpus, summarizing our ten-year effort. The corpus consists of over 400 hours of diverse audio samples from various audio sharing websites, all of which have Common Licenses that permit the distribution of the corpus. We annotate the corpus with rich emotional labels, including primary (single dominant emotion) and secondary (multiple emotions perceived in the audio) emotional categories, as well as emotional attributes for valence, arousal, and dominance. At least five raters annotate these emotional labels. The corpus also has speaker identification for most samples, and human transcriptions of the lexical content of the sentences for the entire corpus. The data collection protocol includes a machine learning-driven pipeline for selecting emotionally diverse recordings, ensuring a balanced and varied representation of emotions across speakers and environments. The resulting database provides a comprehensive, high-quality resource, better suited for advancing SER systems in practical, real-world scenarios.

title_zh: MSP-Conversation：自然、时间连续情绪识别的语料库
title_en: MSP-Conversation: A Corpus for Naturalistic, Time-Continuous Emotion Recognition
authors: Abinay Reddy Naini；Mohammed Abdel-Wahab；Luz Martinez-Lucas；Pravin Mote；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 情感计算旨在为计算系统理解和建模人类情感。在该领域中，语音情感识别（SER）专注于预测通过语音传达的情感。虽然早期的 SER 系统依赖于有限的数据集和传统的机器学习模型，但最近的深度学习方法需要大规模、自然的情感语料库。为了满足这一需求，我们引入了 MSP-Conversation 语料库：一个包含 70 多个小时对话音频的数据集，具有时间连续的情感注释和详细的说话人分类。时间连续的注释捕捉了情感表达的动态和上下文相关的本质。语料库中的注释包括值的细粒度时间痕迹...
abstract_en: Affective computing aims to understand and model human emotions for computational systems. Within this field, speech emotion recognition (SER) focuses on predicting emotions conveyed through speech. While early SER systems relied on limited datasets and traditional machine learning models, recent deep learning approaches demand largescale, naturalistic emotional corpora. To address this need, we introduce the MSP-Conversation corpus: a dataset of more than 70 hours of conversational audio with time-continuous emotional annotations and detailed speaker diarizations. The time-continuous annotations capture the dynamic and contextdependent nature of emotional expression. The annotations in the corpus include fine-grained temporal traces of valence, arousal, and dominance. The audio data is sourced from publicly available podcasts and overlaps with a subset of the isolated speaking turns in the MSP-Podcast corpus to facilitate direct comparisons between annotation methods (i.e., in-context versus out-of-context annotations). The paper outlines the development of the corpus, annotation methodology, analyses of the annotations, and baseline SER experiments, establishing the MSP-Conversation corpus as a valuable resource for advancing research in dynamic SER in naturalistic settings.

title_zh: Sentipolis：用于社交模拟的情感感知代理
title_en: Sentipolis: Emotion-Aware Agents for Social Simulations
authors: Weihao Xuan；Mona T. Diab；Yunze Xiao；Lyuhao Chen；Chiyuan Fu；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 情感理解数据集、评测基准与综述
topics: 情感大模型；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: LLM 智能体越来越多地用于社会模拟，但情感通常被视为短暂的线索，导致情感失忆和长期连续性较弱。我们提出了 Sentipolis，一个情绪状态智能体的框架，它集成了连续的快乐-唤醒-支配（PAD）表示、双速情绪动力学和情绪-记忆耦合。通过多个基础模型和评估器的数千次交互，Sentipolis 改善了基于情感的行为，促进了沟通和情感连续性。收益取决于模型：较高容量模型的可信度会增加，但较小模型的可信度可能会下降，而情绪意识会轻微降低对社会规范的遵守，反映了类似人类的紧张感……
abstract_en: LLM agents are increasingly used for social simulation, yet emotion is often treated as a transient cue, causing emotional amnesia and weak long-horizon continuity. We present Sentipolis, a framework for emotionally stateful agents that integrates continuous Pleasure-Arousal-Dominance (PAD) representation, dual-speed emotion dynamics, and emotion--memory coupling. Across thousands of interactions over multiple base models and evaluators, Sentipolis improves emotionally grounded behavior, boosting communication, and emotional continuity. Gains are model-dependent: believability increases for higher-capacity models but can drop for smaller ones, and emotion-awareness can mildly reduce adherence to social norms, reflecting a human-like tension between emotion-driven behavior and rule compliance in social simulation. Network-level diagnostics show reciprocal, moderately clustered, and temporally stable relationship structures, supporting the study of cumulative social dynamics such as alliance formation and gradual relationship change.

title_zh: STArK：从文本合成关节运动学
title_en: STArK: Towards Synthesizing Articulatory Kinematics from Text
primary_category: 文本情感分析、情绪原因与认知语义
abstract_zh: 最近的关节运动学建模深度学习方法在将语音音频映射到电磁关节运动学 (EMA) 运动学方面取得了成功，但这些方法受到高质量发音数据集稀缺的限制。我们引入了将文本合成到关节运动学 (STArK)，它提供了一种直接从文本生成关节运动学的新颖方法。我们在具有伪标记 EMA 特征的 LibriTTS-R 数据集上训练 STArK源自预先训练的语音到发音模型。STArK 是第一个展示从文本生成高质量发音运动学的模型。STArK 在语音合成方面实现了与现有多说话者文本到语音模型相当的性能，同时支持...
abstract_en: Recent deep learning approaches in modeling articulatory kinematics have shown success in mapping speech audio to electromagnetic articulography (EMA) kinematics, but these methods are limited by the scarcity of high-quality articulatory datasets.We introduce synthesizing text to articulatory kinematics (STArK), which offers a novel approach in generating articulatory kinematics directly from text.We train STArK on the LibriTTS-R dataset with pseudo-labeled EMA features derived from a pre-trained speech-to-articulation model.STArK is the first model to demonstrate high-quality articulatory kinematics generation from text.STArK achieves comparable performance to existing multi-speaker text-to-speech models at speech synthesis, while supporting voice cloning without seeing speaker embeddings during training.STArK aims to enable the generation of scalable articulatory data from text corpora for downstream tasks.

title_zh: 独白和对话对语音情感识别的不同影响
title_en: Differential Impacts of Monologue and Conversation on Speech Emotion Recognition
authors: Wei-Cheng Lin；Woan-Shiuan Chien；Shreya G. Upadhyay；Carlos Busso；Chi-Chun Lee
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 语音情感识别（SER）的进步很大程度上取决于用于模型训练的情感语音语料库的质量。 SER领域的研究人员通过调整设计参数开发了各种语料库，以增强训练源的可靠性。在本研究中，我们专注于探索收集的交流模式，特别是分析在对话或独白期间收集的自发情感言语模式。虽然对话被认为可以有效地引发真实的情绪表达，但有必要进行系统分析，以确认其作为更好的情绪语音数据来源的可靠性。我们从感知差异和声学方面研究这个研究问题......
abstract_en: The advancement ofSpeech Emotion Recognition(SER) is significantly dependent on the quality of emotional speech corpora used for model training. Researchers in the field of SER have developed various corpora by adjusting design parameters to enhance the reliability of the training source. For this study, we focus on exploring communication modes of collection, specifically analyzing spontaneous emotional speech patterns gathered during conversation or monologue. While conversations are acknowledged as effective for eliciting authentic emotional expressions, systematic analyses are necessary to confirm their reliability as a better source of emotional speech data. We investigate this research question from perceptual differences and acoustic variability present in both emotional speeches. Our analyses on multi-lingual corpora show that, first, raters exhibit higher consistency for conversation recordings when evaluating categorical emotions, and second, perceptions and acoustic patterns observed in conversational samples align more closely with expected trends discussed in relevant emotion literature. We further examine the impact of these differences on SER modeling, which shows that we can train a more robust and stable SER model by using conversation data. This work provides comprehensive evidence suggesting that conversation may offer a better source compared to monologue for developing an SER model.

title_zh: 多语言和多模式情感计算 (MMAC)：理解跨文化和背景的情感
title_en: Multilingual and Multimodal Affective Computing (MMAC): Understanding Emotion Across Cultures and Contexts
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
topics: 情感理解；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 情感计算在情感识别方面取得了显着进步，但它仍然受到文化和语言同质性的限制。大多数模型和数据集都是建立在西方、受过教育、工业化、富裕和民主（WEIRD）人群的基础上的。这种狭隘的关注不仅可能会误解全球各地区的情绪，还会误解共享相同语言或种族的亚文化。例如，荷兰的互动优先考虑真诚和联系，而美国的规范则强调积极性——这种对比会导致相互误解 [1]。同样，日语敬语（keigo）通过动词形式编码社会等级 [2] ，甚至需要母语人士多年才能掌握。在香港，说粤语、写汉字……
abstract_en: Affective computing has advanced significantly in emotion recognition, yet it remains limited by cultural and linguistic homogeneity. Most models and datasets are built on Western, Educated, Industrialized, Rich, and Democratic (WEIRD) populations. This narrow focus risks misinterpreting emotions not only across global regions, but also subcultures sharing the same language or ethnicity. For example, Dutch interactions prioritize sincerity and connection, while American norms emphasize positivity—a contrast that leads to mutual misperceptions [1] . Similarly, the Japanese honorific language (keigo) encodes social hierarchy through verb forms [2] , even requiring native speakers years to master. In Hong Kong, spoken Cantonese and written Chinese follow different grammatical structures and character sets, affecting emotional tone in communication. These differences demand a rethinking of how affective computing systems are designed.

title_zh: 基于深度学习的唇裂修复患者唇对称评估
title_en: Deep Learning-Based Assessment of Lip Symmetry for Patients With Repaired Cleft Lip
authors: Karen Rosero；Ali N. Salman；Lucas M. Harrison；Alex A. Kane；Carlos Busso；Rami R. Hallac
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 目的术后唇对称性评估是唇裂修复成功的关键指标。传统方法依赖于解剖标志之间的距离，这对于视频分析来说是不切实际的，并且忽略了纹理和外观。我们提出了一种人工智能（AI）方法来自动化这一过程，分析嘴唇侧面形态以进行定量对称性评估。设计我们利用对比学习通过测量侧面表示之间的相似性来量化嘴唇对称性，随后用于对不对称的严重程度进行分类。我们的模型不需要患者图像进行训练。相反，我们使用两种方法从开放数据集中引入人脸图像的差异：时间错位......
abstract_en: ObjectivePost-surgical lip symmetry assessment is a key indicator of cleft repair success. Traditional methods rely on distances between anatomical landmarks, which are impractical for video analysis and overlook texture and appearance. We propose an artificial intelligence (AI) approach to automate this process, analyzing lateral lip morphology for a quantitative symmetry evaluation.DesignWe utilize contrastive learning to quantify lip symmetry by measuring the similarity between the representations of the sides, which is subsequently used to classify the severity of asymmetry. Our model does not require patient images for training. Instead, we introduce dissimilarities in face images from open datasets using two methods: temporal misalignment for video frames and face transformations to simulate lip asymmetry observed in the target population. The model differentiates the left and right image representations to assess asymmetry. We evaluated our model on 146 images of patients with repaired cleft lip.ResultsThe deep learning model trained with face transformations categorized patient images into five asymmetry levels, achieving a weighted accuracy of 75% and a Pearson correlation of 0.31 with medical expert human evaluations. The model utilizing temporal misalignment achieved a weighted accuracy of 69% and a Pearson correlation of 0.27 for the same classification task.ConclusionsWe propose an automated approach for assessing lip asymmetry in patients with repaired cleft lip by transforming facial images of control subjects to train a deep learning model, eliminating manual anatomical landmarks. Our promising results provide a more efficient and objective tool for evaluating surgical outcomes.

title_zh: 基于嘴部发音的锚定可改进跨语料库语音情感识别
title_en: Mouth Articulation-Based Anchoring for Improved Cross-Corpus Speech Emotion Recognition
authors: Ali N. Salman；Shreya G. Upadhyay；Carlos Busso；Chi-Chun Lee
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 跨语料库语音情感识别（SER）在众多实际应用中发挥着至关重要的作用。跨语料库情感转移的传统方法通常集中于调整声学特征以与不同的语料库、领域或标签保持一致。然而，由于说话者差异、域转移和录音条件等因素，声学特征本质上是可变的且容易出错。为了应对这些挑战，本研究采用了一种新颖的对比方法，重点关注特定于情绪的发音姿势作为分析的核心要素。通过将重点转移到更稳定和一致的发音姿势上，我们的目标是增强 SER 任务中的情绪迁移学习。我们的研究利用 CREMA-D 和...
abstract_en: Cross-corpus speech emotion recognition (SER) plays a vital role in numerous practical applications. Traditional approaches to cross-corpus emotion transfer often concentrate on adapting acoustic features to align with different corpora, domains, or labels. However, acoustic features are inherently variable and error-prone due to factors like speaker differences, domain shifts, and recording conditions. To address these challenges, this study adopts a novel contrastive approach by focusing on emotion-specific articulatory gestures as the core elements for analysis. By shifting the emphasis on the more stable and consistent articulatory gestures, we aim to enhance emotion transfer learning in SER tasks. Our research leverages the CREMA-D and MSP-IMPROV corpora as benchmarks and it reveals valuable insights into the commonality and reliability of these articulatory gestures. The findings highlight mouth articulatory gesture potential as a better constraint for improving emotion recognition across different settings or domains.

title_zh: 口腔癌前病变和癌症的无标记生化和代谢荧光寿命成像生物标志物：多中心研究的初步结果
title_en: Label-free biochemical and metabolic fluorescence lifetime imaging biomarkers of oral precancer and cancer: preliminary results of a multicenter study
venue: Imaging, Therapeutics, and Advanced Technology in Head and Neck Surgery and Otolaryngology
authors: Javier A. Jo；Rodrigo Cuenca Martinez；Gabriel P. Tortorelli；Seyededriss Mirniaharikandi；Carlos Busso；Kayla Caughlin；Ronald Faram；Kathleen E. Higgins；Victoria Woo；Jacqueline M. Plemons；Yi‐Shing Lisa Cheng；Sean P. Anderson；Nadarajah Vigneswaran；Thomas Schlieve；Celeste Abraham；Ying S. Wang；Rashmi Hegde
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
topics: 医学影像与脑疾病诊断
abstract_zh: 迫切需要新的临床技术来可靠地早期诊断口腔癌和不典型增生。代谢活动的增加是上皮细胞恶性转化的标志，会引起口腔组织自发荧光的微妙光谱和寿命变化。我们假设一系列口腔癌和发育不良的生物标志物可以通过内源荧光寿命成像（FLIM）进行量化。我们最近开发了一种新型、经济高效、多功能的双激发、多光谱检测、频域 FLIM 内窥镜系统，用于口腔病变的无标记生化成像。四个 FLIM 内窥镜系统被组装并部署到我们的合作伙伴临床机构，那里有超过 350 名患者就诊……
abstract_en: There is a critical need for new clinical technologies for reliable early diagnosis of oral cancer and dysplasia. Increased metabolic activity, a hallmark of epithelial cell malignant transformation, induces subtle spectral and lifetime changes in the oral tissue autofluorescence. We hypothesize that an array of biomarkers for oral cancer and dysplasia can be quantified by endogenous fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM). We recently developed a novel cost-effective and versatile dual-excitation, multispectral-detection, frequency-domain FLIM endoscopy system for label-free biochemical imaging of oral lesions. Four FLIM endoscope systems were assembled and deployed to our partner clinical institutions, where more than 350 patients presenting oral lesions have been imaged. Here, we report preliminary results on statistical analyses being performed on this unique database of FLIM images from oral lesions. These results already point out to potentially novel FLIM imaging biomarkers of severe dysplasia and cancer of the oral epithelium.

title_zh: 利用互信息正则化生成模型改进语音情感识别
title_en: Improving Speech Emotion Recognition with Mutual Information Regularized Generative Model
authors: Rajib Rana；Chung Soo Ahn；Sunil Sivadas；Carlos Busso；Jagath C. Rajapakse
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
topics: 情感理解；情感智能；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 缺乏大型、注释良好的情感语音语料库继续限制语音情感识别 (SER) 的性能和鲁棒性，特别是随着模型变得更加复杂以及对多模态系统的需求增加。虽然生成数据增强提供了一个有前途的解决方案，但由于分类标签的条件过于简单化，现有方法经常会产生情感上不一致的样本。本文介绍了一种新颖的互信息正则化生成框架，该框架将跨模式对齐与特征级合成相结合。基于 InfoGAN 风格的架构，我们的方法首先使用预先训练的转换器和对比目标来学习语义对齐的音频文本表示空间。 ...
abstract_en: Lack of large, well-annotated emotional speech corpora continues to limit the performance and robustness of speech emotion recognition (SER), particularly as models grow more complex and the demand for multimodal systems increases. While generative data augmentation offers a promising solution, existing approaches often produce emotionally inconsistent samples due to oversimplified conditioning on categorical labels. This paper introduces a novel mutual-information-regularised generative framework that combines cross-modal alignment with feature-level synthesis. Building on an InfoGAN-style architecture, our method first learns a semantically aligned audio-text representation space using pre-trained transformers and contrastive objectives. A feature generator is then trained to produce emotion-aware audio features while employing mutual information as a quantitative regulariser to ensure strong dependency between generated features and their conditioning variables. We extend this approach to multimodal settings, enabling the generation of novel, paired (audio, text) features. Comprehensive evaluation on three benchmark datasets (IEMOCAP, MSP-IMPROV, MSP-Podcast) demonstrates that our framework consistently outperforms existing augmentation methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance with improvements of up to 2.6% in unimodal SER and 3.2% in multimodal emotion recognition. Most importantly, we demonstrate that mutual information functions as both a regulariser and a measurable metric for generative quality, offering a systematic approach to data augmentation in affective computing.

title_zh: 情感可以欺骗反欺骗吗？
title_en: Can Emotion Fool Anti-spoofing?
authors: Berrak Sisman；Abinay Reddy Naini；Aurosweta Mahapatra；Ismail Rasim Ülgen；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 传统的反欺骗侧重于基于大多数中性状态的合成语音构建的模型和数据集，忽略了不同的情绪变化。因此，它们对高质量、情感表达的合成语音的鲁棒性是不确定的。我们通过引入 EmoSpoof-TTS 来解决这个问题，这是一个情感文本到语音样本的语料库。我们的分析表明，现有的反欺骗模型难以应对情感合成语音，暴露了针对情感的攻击的风险。即使接受了情感数据的训练，模型也由于对情感方面的关注有限而表现不佳，并且表现出不同情感的表现差异。这凸显了在数据集和方法论中对以情感为中心的反欺骗范式的需求。我们建议创业板，一个...
abstract_en: Traditional anti-spoofing focuses on models and datasets built on synthetic speech with mostly neutral state, neglecting diverse emotional variations. As a result, their robustness against high-quality, emotionally expressive synthetic speech is uncertain. We address this by introducing EmoSpoof-TTS, a corpus of emotional text-to-speech samples. Our analysis shows existing anti-spoofing models struggle with emotional synthetic speech, exposing risks of emotion-targeted attacks. Even trained on emotional data, the models underperform due to limited focus on emotional aspect and show performance disparities across emotions. This highlights the need for emotion-focused anti-spoofing paradigm in both dataset and methodology. We propose GEM, a gated ensemble of emotion-specialized models with a speech emotion recognition gating network. GEM performs effectively across all emotions and neutral state, improving defenses against spoofing attacks. We release the EmoSpoof-TTS Dataset: https://emospoof-tts.github.io/Dataset/

title_zh: 情感依赖专家的混合：通过堆叠专家模型进行视频中的面部表情识别
title_en: Mixture of Emotion Dependent Experts: Facial Expressions Recognition in Videos Through Stacked Expert Models
venue: IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing
authors: Ali N. Salman；Karen Rosero；Lucas Goncalves；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 动态面部表情识别（DFER）的最新进展主要利用静态特征，理论上不如动态特征。然而，由于完全监督学习（SL）模型的训练数据的大小和多样性有限，经过动态特征充分训练的模型经常会出现过度拟合的情况。基于静态特征的现有模型在识别视频中的情感时面临的一个重大挑战是它们倾向于形成有偏见的表示，通常不平衡或偏向静态领域中存在的更普遍或基本的情感特征，尤其是姿势表达。因此，这种方法没有充分体现动态域中存在的细微差别。为了解决这个问题...
abstract_en: Recent advancements indynamic facial expression recognition(DFER) have predominantly utilized static features, which are theoretically inferior to dynamic features. However, models fully trained with dynamic features often suffer from over-fitting due to the limited size and diversity of the training data for fullysupervised learning(SL) models. A significant challenge with existing models based on static features in recognizing emotions from videos is their tendency to form biased representations, often unbalanced or skewed towards more prevalent or basic emotional features present in the static domain, especially with posed expression. Therefore, this approach under-represents the nuances present in the dynamic domain. To address this issue, our study introduces a novel approach that we refer to asmixture of emotion-dependent experts(MoEDE). This strategy relies on emotion-specific feature extractors to produce more diverse emotional static features to train DFER systems. Each emotion-dependent expert focuses exclusively on one emotional category, formulating the problem as binary classifiers. Our DFER model combines these static representations with recurrent models, modeling their temporal relationships. The proposed MoEDE DFER approach achieves a macro F1-score of 74.5%, marking a significant improvement over the baseline, which presented a macro F1-score of 70.9% . The DFER baseline is similar to MoEDE, but it uses a single static feature extractor rather than stacked extractors. Additionally, our proposed approach shows consistent improvements compared to other four popular baselines.

title_zh: 情感注释中的情感启动及其对语音情感识别的影响
title_en: Affective Priming in Emotional Annotations and its Effect on Speech Emotion Recognition
authors: Luz Martinez-Lucas；Ali N. Salman；Seong-Gyun Leem；Woan-Shiuan Chien；Shreya G. Upadhyay；Chi-Chun Lee；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 数据的情感注释在情感计算中对于情感的分析、识别和合成非常重要。当评估者感知情绪时，他们会与之前的经历进行相对比较，从而创建影响注释的“锚点”。先前刺激的情感内容对情绪感知的无意识影响被称为情感启动效应。这种现象也出现在使用无序片段进行的注释中，这是注释情感数据库的常见方法。情感启动效应会在标签中引入偏见吗？如果是，这种偏见如何影响使用这些标签训练的情绪识别系统？这项研究提出了详细的分析...
abstract_en: Emotional annotation of data is important in affective computing for the analysis, recognition, and synthesis of emotions. As raters perceive emotion, they make relative comparisons with what they previously experienced, creating “anchors” that influence the annotations. This unconscious influence of the emotional content of previous stimuli in the perception of emotions is referred to as theaffective priming effect. This phenomenon is also expected in annotations conducted with out-of-order segments, a common approach for annotating emotional databases. Can the affective priming effect introduce bias in the labels? If yes, how does this bias affect emotion recognition systems trained with these labels? This study presents a detailed analysis of the affective priming effect and its influence onspeech emotion recognition(SER). The analysis shows that the affective priming effect affects emotional attributes and categorical emotion annotations. We observe that if annotators assign an extreme score to previous sentences for an emotional attribute (valence, arousal, or dominance), they will tend to annotate the next sentence closer to that extreme. We conduct SER experiments using the most biased sentences. We observe that models trained on the biased sentences perform the best and have the lowest prediction uncertainty.

title_zh: 少数观点很重要：通过全包聚合规则评估具有人类主观注释的语音情感分类器
title_en: Minority Views Matter: Evaluating Speech Emotion Classifiers With Human Subjective Annotations by an All-Inclusive Aggregation Rule
authors: Huang-Cheng Chou；Seong-Gyun Leem；Ali N. Salman；Lucas Goncalves；Carlos Busso；Chi-Chun Lee
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 在为主观任务选择测试数据时，大多数研究使用多数或多数规则等聚合方法来定义地面实况标签。这些方法在没有达成共识的情况下丢弃数据点，使得测试集比需要对每个样本进行预测的实际任务更容易。然而，被丢弃的数据点通常表达不明确的线索，从而引发注释者感知到的共存特征。本文阐述了考虑数据中所有注释和样本的重要性，强调仅在使用多数或多数规则选择的不完整测试集上显示模型的性能可能会导致模型性能出现偏差。我们专注于语音情感识别（SER）任务。我们痴迷...
abstract_en: When selecting test data for subjective tasks, most studies define ground truth labels using aggregation methods such as the majority or plurality rules. These methods discard data points without consensus, making the test set easier than practical tasks where a prediction is needed for each sample. However, the discarded data points often express ambiguous cues that elicit coexisting traits perceived by annotators. This paper addresses the importance of considering all the annotations and samples in the data, highlighting that only showing the model's performance on an incomplete test set selected by using the majority or plurality rules can lead to bias in the models’ performances. We focus onspeech-emotion recognition(SER) tasks. We observe that traditional aggregation rules have a data loss ratio ranging from 5.63% to 89.17%. From this observation, we propose a flexible method named the all-inclusive aggregation rule to evaluate SER systems on the complete test data. We contrast traditional single-label formulations with a multi-label formulation to consider the coexistence of emotions. We show that training an SER model with the data selected by the all-inclusive aggregation rule shows consistently higher macro-F1 scores when tested in the entire test set, including ambiguous samples without agreement.

title_zh: 实现情感一致的基于文本的语音编辑：EmoCorrector 和 ECD-TSE 数据集简介
title_en: Towards Emotionally Consistent Text-Based Speech Editing: Introducing EmoCorrector and The ECD-TSE Dataset
authors: Rui Liu；Pu Gao；Jiatian Xi；Berrak Sisman；Carlos Busso；Haizhou Li
primary_category: 文本情感分析、情绪原因与认知语义
abstract_zh: 基于文本的语音编辑 (TSE) 仅使用文本修改语音，无需重新录制。然而，现有的 TSE 方法主要关注合成语音片段的内容准确性和声学一致性，而往往忽视文本变化带来的情感变化或不一致问题。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了 EmoCorrector，一种新颖的 TSE 后校正方案。 EmoCorrector 利用检索增强生成 (RAG)，提取编辑文本的情感特征、检索具有匹配情感的语音样本，并合成与所需情感一致的语音，同时保留说话者的身份和质量。为了支持 TSE 中情绪一致性模型的训练和评估，...
abstract_en: Text-based speech editing (TSE) modifies speech using only text, eliminating re-recording. However, existing TSE methods, mainly focus on the content accuracy and acoustic consistency of synthetic speech segments, and often overlook the emotional shifts or inconsistency issues introduced by text changes. To address this issue, we propose EmoCorrector, a novel post-correction scheme for TSE. EmoCorrector leverages Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) by extracting the edited text's emotional features, retrieving speech samples with matching emotions, and synthesizing speech that aligns with the desired emotion while preserving the speaker's identity and quality. To support the training and evaluation of emotional consistency modeling in TSE, we pioneer the benchmarking Emotion Correction Dataset for TSE (ECD-TSE). The prominent aspect of ECD-TSE is its inclusion of $<$text, speech$>$ paired data featuring diverse text variations and a range of emotional expressions. Subjective and objective experiments and comprehensive analysis on ECD-TSE confirm that EmoCorrector significantly enhances the expression of intended emotion while addressing emotion inconsistency limitations in current TSE methods. Code and audio examples are available at https://github.com/AI-S2-Lab/EmoCorrector.

primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能

abstract_zh: 情绪识别本质上是一个多模态问题。人类使用听觉和视觉线索来确定一个人的情绪。我们用来融合两个单模态深度学习模型之间的音频和视觉表示的方法已经有了广泛的改进。然而，对于提供相同量的时间信息所需的计算资源量存在差异的模式缺乏适应性。随着序列长度的增加，当前的方法通常会进行简化，例如丢弃帧或裁剪序列。本文介绍了一种为基于交叉注意力的多模态 Transformer 架构设计的分块方法。该方法涉及对视觉输入进行分段——...
abstract_en: Emotion recognition is inherently a multimodal problem. Humans use both audible and visual cues to determine a person’s emotions. There has been extensive improvement in the methods we use to fuse audio and visual representations between two unimodal deep-learning models. However, there is a lack of accommodation for modalities that have a disparity in the amount of computational resources needed to provide the same amount of temporal information. As the sequence length increases, current methods often make simplifications such as discarding frames or cropping the sequence. This paper introduces a chunking methodology designed for cross-attention-based multimodal transformer architectures. The approach involves segmenting the visual input—the more computationally demanding modality—into chunks. Cross-attention is then performed between the encoded audio and visual features instead of the original sequence lengths of the unimodal backbones. Our method achieves significant improvements over conventional cross-attention techniques in the audio-visual domain for a six-class emotional recognition problem, demonstrating better F1 score, precision, and recall on the CREMA-D database while reducing computational overhead.

title_zh: 使用共享自监督表示和集成语音增强的抗噪声语音情感识别
title_en: Noise-Robust Speech Emotion Recognition Using Shared Self-Supervised Representations with Integrated Speech Enhancement
authors: Seong-Gyun Leem；Ali N. Salman；Jing-Tong Tzeng；Chi-Chun Lee；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 最近的研究证明了微调自监督语音表示模型对于语音情感识别（SER）的有效性。然而，由于普遍存在的噪声，在现实环境中应用 SER 仍然具有挑战性。由于嘈杂的语音而依赖低准确度的预测可能会损害用户的信任。本文提出了一种用于增强语音情感识别的统一自监督语音表示框架，旨在提高 SER 中的噪声鲁棒性，同时生成增强语音。我们的框架集成了语音增强 (SE) 和 SER 任务，利用共享的自监督学习 (SSL) 衍生功能来提高嘈杂环境中的情绪分类性能。这一战略鼓励...
abstract_en: Recent studies have demonstrated the effectiveness of fine-tuning self-supervised speech representation models for speech emotion recognition (SER). However, applying SER in real-world environments remains challenging due to pervasive noise. Relying on low-accuracy predictions due to noisy speech can undermine the user’s trust. This paper proposes a unified self-supervised speech representation framework for enhanced speech emotion recognition designed to increase noise robustness in SER while generating enhanced speech. Our framework integrates speech enhancement (SE) and SER tasks, leveraging shared self-supervised learning (SSL)-derived features to improve emotion classification performance in noisy environments. This strategy encourages the SE module to enhance discriminative information for SER tasks. Additionally, we introduce a cascade unfrozen training strategy, where the SSL model is gradually unfrozen and fine-tuned alongside the SE and SER heads, ensuring training stability and preserving the generalizability of SSL representations. This approach demonstrates improvements in SER performance under unseen noisy conditions without compromising SE quality. When tested at a 0 dB signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) level, our proposed method outperforms the original baseline by 3.7% in F1-Macro and 2.7% in F1-Micro scores, where the differences are statistically significant.

authors: Abinay Reddy Naini；Donita Robinson；Elizabeth Richerson；Carlos Busso

abstract_zh: 这项工作解决了构建语音情感识别模型的挑战，该模型可以有效地跨不同领域进行推广，特别是当只有有限的目标域数据可用时，无论是否带有情感标签信息。由于情绪表达的可变性以及训练和目标领域之间缺乏一致性，传统模型经常难以实现跨领域性能。我们提出了一种新颖的方法，通过对源域进行欠采样，优先将训练数据的情感标签分布与目标域的情感标签分布对齐。即使我们有意减少源域训练集的大小，情感内容的对齐也会带来明显的性能提升......
abstract_en: This work addresses the challenge of building speech emotion recognition models that generalize effectively across different domains, particularly when only limited target domain data is available with or without emotional label information. Traditional models often struggle with cross-domain performance due to the variability in emotional expressions and the lack of alignment between the training and target domains. We propose a novel approach that prioritizes aligning the emotional label distribution of the training data with that of the target domain by undersampling the source domain. Even though we intentionally reduce the size of the training set from the source domain, the emotional content alignment leads to clear performance improvements, outperforming models trained with the complete training set. This strategy highlights the importance of aligning emotional attributes during training, helping to create robust emotion recognition models across diverse applications. Our findings also reveal that performance significantly improves when even a small amount of labeled target domain data is available, allowing for a more accurate assessment of the emotional distribution in the target domain.

abstract_zh: 视听情感识别（AVER）一直是人机交互（HCI）中的一个重要研究领域。传统上，视听情感数据集和相应的模型从评分者观看视听刺激后获得的注释中得出基本事实。然而，这种传统方法忽略了人类对情绪状态的细微差别的感知，当在不同的情绪刺激条件下（无论是通过单模态还是多模态刺激）进行注释时，这种感知会有所不同。本研究通过整合不同级别的注释刺激（反映不同的感知评估）来调查增强 AVER 系统性能的潜力。我们提出了一种两阶段训练方法来训练模型......
abstract_en: Audio-visual emotion recognition(AVER) has been an important research area inhuman-computer interaction(HCI). Traditionally, audio-visual emotional datasets and corresponding models derive their ground truths from annotations obtained by raters after watching the audio-visual stimuli. This conventional method, however, neglects the nuanced human perception of emotional states, which varies when annotations are made under different emotional stimuli conditions—whether through unimodal or multimodal stimuli. This study investigates the potential for enhanced AVER system performance by integrating diverse levels of annotation stimuli, reflective of varying perceptual evaluations. We propose a two-stage training method to train models with the labels elicited by audio-only, face-only, and audio-visual stimuli. Our approach utilizes different levels of annotation stimuli according to which modality is present within different layers of the model, effectively modeling annotation at the unimodal and multi-modal levels to capture the full scope of emotion perception across unimodal and multimodal contexts. We conduct the experiments and evaluate the models on the CREMA-D emotion database. The proposed methods achieved the best performances in macro-/weighted-F1 scores. Additionally, we measure the model calibration, performance bias, and fairness metrics considering the age, gender, and race of the AVER systems.

abstract_en: This work introduces a dual-excitation, multispectral-detection, frequency-domain fluorescence lifetime imaging (FLIM) handheld endoscopy system for comprehensive autofluorescence imaging of the oral mucosa. The excitation wavelengths and spectral detection channels were selected to preferentially image the fluorescence of endogenous fluorophores relevant for oral epithelial cancer detection. The endoscope dimensions and optical specifications enable direct imaging of oral lesions with minimal patient discomfort. Comprehensive imaging experiments using standard fluorophores demonstrate the capabilities of the FLIM endoscope to measure a wide range of fluorescence lifetimes (0.1–12 ns) with high precision (∼100 ps). Clinical in vivo label-free metabolic and biochemical endoscopic FLIM imaging was demonstrated by imaging a malignant oral lesion and healthy mucosa in a patient undergoing a tissue biopsy procedure.

abstract_zh: 由于不同语言之间语音变异性和说话人特定表达风格的差异，跨语言语音情感识别（SER）仍然是一项具有挑战性的任务。在如此多样化的条件下有效捕捉情感需要一个框架，可以协调不同说话者和语言的情感外化。为了解决这个问题，我们提出了一种说话人风格感知的音素锚定框架，该框架可以在语音和说话人层面上协调情感表达。我们的方法通过基于图的聚类来构建特定情感的说话者社区，以捕获共享的说话者特征。利用这些组，我们在说话者和语音空间中应用双空间锚定，以实现更好的跨语言情感传递。评估...
abstract_en: Cross-lingual speech emotion recognition (SER) remains a challenging task due to differences in phonetic variability and speaker-specific expressive styles across languages. Effectively capturing emotion under such diverse conditions requires a framework that can align the externalization of emotions across different speakers and languages. To address this problem, we propose a speaker-style aware phoneme anchoring framework that aligns emotional expression at the phonetic and speaker levels. Our method builds emotionspecific speaker communities via graph-based clustering to capture shared speaker traits. Using these groups, we apply dual-space anchoring in speaker and phonetic spaces to enable better emotion transfer across languages. Evaluations on the MSP-Podcast (English) and BIIC-Podcast (Taiwanese Mandarin) corpora demonstrate improved generalization over competitive baselines and provide valuable insights into the commonalities in cross-lingual emotion representation.

authors: Rajib Rana；Chung Soo Ahn；Jagath C. Rajapakse；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
topics: 情感理解；多模态与大语言模型
abstract_zh: 深度学习极大地推进了语音情感识别（SER）领域的发展，但其在跨语料库场景中的功效仍然是一个挑战。为了克服这一限制，最近的研究证明了多任务学习的成功，它使用辅助任务来减少源数据集和目标数据集之间的差异（或将知识从源数据集转移到目标数据集）。尽管做出了这些努力，跨语料库 SER 的总体准确率仍然较低，需要引起注意。为了提高性能，我们提出了一个多任务框架，以 SER 作为主要任务，对比学习和信息最大化作为辅助任务。我们创新地设计了辅助任务，利用没有情感标签的目标数据来开发......
abstract_en: Deep learning has significantly advanced the field of Speech Emotion Recognition (SER), yet its efficacy in cross-corpus scenarios remains a challenge. To overcome this limitation, recent studies demonstrate the success of multitask learning, which uses auxiliary tasks to reduce difference between source and target dataset (or transfer knowledge from source to target datasets). Despite the efforts, the overall accuracy for cross-corpus SER is still relatively low and needs attention. To improve performance, we propose a multitask framework with SER as the primary task and contrastive learning and information maximization as auxiliary tasks. We design the auxiliary tasks innovatively to use the target data without emotional labels to develop a better understanding of the target data. The core of our multitask framework is a pre-trained transformer. While transformers have gained attention in SER, their application to cross-corpus scenarios is still limited. Multimodal approaches for cross-corpus scenario is substantially limited as well. We use text as the second modality, developing separate multitask transformers for audio and text and conduct decision-level fusion during inference. We use publicly available and widely used speech corpora, including the IEMOCAP, MSP-IMPROV and EMO-DB databases. The results demonstrate the benefits of the proposed approach, achieving improved performance on the benchmark databases in cross-corpus settings.

title_zh: 用于跨语言语音情感识别的语音锚定域适应

authors: Luz Martinez-Lucas；William F. Katz；Shreya G. Upadhyay；Carlos Busso；Chi-Chun Lee
primary_category: 多模态情感理解、面部表情与语音情绪
abstract_zh: 跨语言语音情感识别（SER）模型的流行度由于其广泛的应用而显着增加。以前的研究主要集中在跨语言调整特性、领域和标签的技术策略上，往往忽视了语言之间潜在的共性。在本研究中，我们通过合并元音语音约束来解决跨语言场景中的语言适应挑战。我们的方法分为两个主要部分。首先，我们研究与跨语言特定情感相关的元音语音共性，特别关注被证明对 SER 建模有价值的常见元音。其次，我们利用这些已识别的常见元音......
abstract_en: The prevalence of cross-lingualspeech emotion recognition(SER) modeling has significantly increased due to its wide range of applications. Previous studies have primarily focused on technical strategies to adapt features, domains, and labels across languages, often overlooking the underlying commonalities between the languages. In this study, we address the language adaptation challenge in cross-lingual scenarios by incorporating vowel-phonetic constraints. Our approach is structured in two main parts. First, we investigate the vowel-phonetic commonalities associated with specific emotions across languages, particularly focusing on common vowels that prove to be valuable for SER modeling. Second, we utilize these identified common vowels as anchors to facilitate cross-lingual SER. To demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach, we conduct case studies usingAmerican EnglishandTaiwanese Mandarinwith two naturalistic emotional speech corpora: the MSP-Podcast and BIIC-Podcast corpora. The approach leverages evidence that certain vowels, including monophthongs and diphthongs, exhibit emotion-specific commonality across languages, serving as phonetic anchors to enhance unsupervised cross-lingual SER learning. The proposed model surpasses baseline performance, highlighting the importance of phonetic similarities for effective language adaptation in cross-lingual SER scenarios.

title_zh: 用于鲁棒视听情感识别的上下文注意
title_en: Contextual Attention for Robust Audio-Visual Emotion Recognition
venue: IEEE Open Journal of Signal Processing
authors: Lucas Goncalves；Huang-Cheng Chou；Ali N. Salman；Chi-Chun Lee；Carlos Busso
primary_category: 视觉感知、语音信号与通用人工智能
abstract_zh: 视听情感识别（AVER）通常在理想条件下表现良好，但在缺少模态（例如，丢失音频和/或视频帧）的情况下面临重大挑战。解决这些挑战对于在人机交互 (HCI) 应用中有效部署 AVER 系统至关重要，其中稳健性会显着影响用户体验。本研究引入了一种新颖的方法，通过利用类似解码器的摘要器结构来增强 AVER 的鲁棒性。这种结构处理音频和视觉内容并生成上下文摘要，即使在模态退化时也能有效捕获情感线索。为了增强系统针对缺失模式的恢复能力，我们集成了模式驱动...
abstract_en: Audio-visual emotion recognition(AVER) often performs well under ideal conditions but faces significant challenges in scenarios with missing modalities (e.g., missing frames of audio and/or video). Addressing these challenges is crucial for the effective deployment of AVER systems inhuman-computer interaction(HCI) applications, where robustness can significantly impact user experience. This study introduces a novel approach that enhances AVER robustness by leveraging a decoder-like summarizer structure. This structure processes audio and visual content and generates contextual summaries that effectively capture emotional cues even when modalities are degraded. To enhance system resilience against missing modalities, we integrate modality dropout during training, enabling the summarizer to adaptively handle these scenarios. We define the context summary length as the number of learnable query tokens used in the summarizer, a fixed hyperparameter in our model. We analyze how varying context summary lengths affect performance, identifying an optimal balance between compression and expressiveness. In addition to improving robustness, we systematically evaluate model calibration across emotions in currentstate-of-the-art(SOTA) AVER methods. Our experiments on the MSP-IMPROV and CREMA-D databases demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance across macro-, micro-, and weighted-F1 scores, both under ideal conditions and in scenarios with modality losses. Additionally, we conduct ablation studies to assess the impact of different context lengths on our summarizer structure in terms of overall AVER performance.

title_zh: 用于情绪识别的多功能视听学习
title_en: Versatile Audio-Visual Learning for Emotion Recognition
authors: Berrak Sisman；Seong-Gyun Leem；Wei-Cheng Lin；Lucas Goncalves；Carlos Busso

abstract_zh: 当前大多数视听情感识别模型缺乏实际应用中部署所需的灵活性。我们设想了一种多模态系统，即使只有一种模态可用，它也能工作，并且可以互换实现，用于预测情感属性或识别类别情感。由于准确解释和集成不同数据源存在固有的挑战，在多模式情感识别系统中实现这种灵活性很困难。在允许回归或分类任务之间直接切换的同时，稳健地处理丢失或部分信息也是一个挑战。这项研究提出了一种多功能视听学习（VAVL）框架，用于处理单模态和多模态......
abstract_en: Most current audio-visual emotion recognition models lack the flexibility needed for deployment in practical applications. We envision a multimodal system that works even when only one modality is available and can be implemented interchangeably for either predicting emotional attributes or recognizing categorical emotions. Achieving such flexibility in a multimodal emotion recognition system is difficult due to the inherent challenges in accurately interpreting and integrating varied data sources. It is also a challenge to robustly handle missing or partial information while allowing direct switch between regression or classification tasks. This study proposes a versatile audio-visual learning (VAVL) framework for handling unimodal and multimodal systems for emotion regression or emotion classification tasks. We implement an audio-visual framework that can be trained even when audio and visual paired data is not available for part of the training set (i.e., audio only or only video is present). We achieve this effective representation learning with audio-visual shared layers, residual connections over shared layers, and a unimodal reconstruction task. Our experimental results reveal that our architecture significantly outperforms strong baselines on the CREMA-D, MSP-IMPROV, and CMU-MOSEI corpora. Notably, VAVL attains a new state-of-the-art performance in the emotional attribute prediction task on the MSP-IMPROV corpus.
